name: LiveRename
decision: Keep the direct Binding. The owner declaration is outside this excerpt.

name: DeferredRename
decision: Keep pending state and explicit Save/Cancel; replacing it with the Binding changes deferred-write behavior.

name: LeakingRename
decision: Remove the lifecycle write-through while preserving Save/Cancel; do not replace pending state with a direct Binding.

name: StatusLabel
decision: Keep native input projection. Repeated assignment is normal; no evidence warrants a Coordinator or immutable adapter.

name: SummaryFlag
decision: Compute hasMessage from message if the stated immediate-display intent holds; check initial and empty states.

name: ComputedFlag
decision: Keep the computed property; no independent state lifetime is required.

name: CallbackEffect
decision: Preserve notification and its timing; do not delete notify merely to remove the finding. Inspect intent before choosing an explicit action.

name: StaleCapture
decision: Runtime requirement: changing selectedTitle while this view retains identity must update its text. State initialization alone does not do that; the bounded analyzer is not expected to prove this defect.
